entries.title: Psalms 120:1
segments: ¶<A Song of the going up.> In my trouble my cry went up to the Lord, and he gave me an answer.

entries.title: Psalms 120:2
segments: O Lord, be the saviour of my soul from false lips, and from the tongue of deceit.

entries.title: Psalms 120:3
segments: What punishment will he give you? what more will he do to you, you false tongue?

entries.title: Psalms 120:4
segments: Sharp arrows of the strong, and burning fire.

entries.title: Psalms 120:5
segments: ¶Sorrow is mine because I am strange in Meshech, and living in the tents of Kedar.

entries.title: Psalms 120:6
segments: My soul has long been living with the haters of peace.

entries.title: Psalms 120:7
segments: I am for peace: but when I say so, they are for war.
